summary: Coerce Optional[bool] to bool in PathSpec.match_file() so it returns False (not None) when no patterns match. Add a regression test asserting match_file() returns False for an empty spec.
risks: Very small. Only changes PathSpec.match_file() return value by wrapping include in bool(); other APIs that rely on CheckResult (which permits include to be None) are unaffected. Some callers that previously relied on distinguishing None vs False from match_file() (if any) would now always get a bool.
warning: LLM patch draft. Not applied, tested, or approved. Review before Docker execution.
